is_anopheles.evidence: Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. M and S forms, and An. arabiensis) were collected and tested (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotyped the Vgsc 1014 locus (kdr-west L995F / 1014F and kdr-east L995S / 1014S) using the hot oligonucleotide ligation assay (HOLA) (Page 4, Methods; Table 2; Figure 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives sample sizes (N) and allele frequencies for 1014L, 1014F, and 1014S across species/forms in survivors of DDT, permethrin, and deltamethrin. Figure 3 presents exact genotype proportions and sample sizes (N) for permethrin survivors and dead mosquitoes.

african_field_population.evidence: Field collections of An. gambiae s.l. larvae/pupae were carried out between October 2008 and May 2009 across six localities in Cameroon (Nkolondom, Nkolbikon, Bonanloka, Campo, Makoutchietoum, Pitoa) (Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting empirical field collections, WHO bioassays, molecular species/kdr genotyping, and biochemical assays.

sub_country_location.evidence: Precise geographic coordinates and descriptions are provided for all six collection localities in Cameroon (Page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between October 2008 and May 2009 (Page 2, Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The field collections and bioassays/genotyping were performed directly by the authors as part of an independent survey.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequencies, sample sizes, bioassay results, and site coordinates are contained within the main text, tables, and figures.

assessment.summary: This primary study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and resistance mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from six localities across Cameroon collected between October 2008 and May 2009. WHO susceptibility tests with DDT, permethrin, and deltamethrin (with and without synergists DEF, DEM, PBO) were conducted. Genotyping for Vgsc L995F and L995S (1014F/1014S) was performed on bioassay survivors and dead mosquitoes, providing extractable allele and genotype frequencies linked to phenotypic response.
